answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond with slashing: each agent must lock stake to a single on-chain identity before trading, and misbehavior burns that stake. Picture a wharf where every trader deposits 100 tokens before docking; honest agents reclaim it, cheaters forfeit. A sybil spinning up 1,000 fake agents needs 1,000 separate bonds = 100,000 tokens at risk, not one. The attacker cannot echo a single deposit across clones, and no ivory-tower reputation is granted for free, so cost scales linearly with identities and mass sybils become uneconomical.
